name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: data_fd2_ game-global prefix, battle domain (pathfind is part of the battle subsystem), descriptor pathfind_floodfill_seed_y accurately reflects purpose (flood-fill/pathfind origin tile Y / source row). 'seed_y' is a coordinate-axis label, not a Ghidra address residue (the hex address is 0x6006f, unrelated). Scalar coordinate byte; convention does not require a type suffix for scalars and the name is unambiguous.
purpose: Flood-fill / pathfind origin tile Y (source row): one of the contiguous seed block (seed_x@0x6006E / seed_y@0x6006F / max_steps@0x60070) written by both pathfind orchestrators at entry.
logic_summary: Single unsigned byte. Written at entry by fd2_init_movement_range_floodfill (0x4E058) and fd2_pathfind_to_destination (0x4E1BE) from the src_y argument truncated to its low byte. Read 8-bit unsigned as (a) the multiplier in the origin tile-index math map_width * seed_y (MUL AH at 0x4E09B / 0x4E221) and (b) reloaded into DH as the starting y coordinate handed to the recursive expander (MOV DH at 0x4E0C0 / 0x4E246). Scalar, not an array (0x6006E is the separate seed_x field, 0x60070 the separate max_steps). Zero at load (.object3 BSS); write-before-read so the load value is never observed.
element_semantics: Origin tile Y coordinate (source row), 0..255 (game tile-map rows fit in a byte); used unsigned both as the row multiplier in (map_width*seed_y+seed_x) origin index math and as the DH starting-y for the recursive 4-neighbour pathfind/flood-fill.
notes: Verified against live Ghidra: symbol name byte-identical, datatype byte len 1, value 0 (BSS). Xrefs confirm 2 WRITE (0x4E058 fd2_init_movement_range_floodfill, 0x4E1BE fd2_pathfind_to_destination) + 4 READ (0x4E09B, 0x4E0C0 in fd2_init; 0x4E221, 0x4E246 in fd2_pathfind_to_destination), all pathfind, matching src comment (lines 827-840) and the Ghidra PRE comment. Disassembly at 0x4E09B (MOV AH,[0x6006f];MUL AH) and 0x4E0C0 (MOV DH,[0x6006f]) confirms the documented multiplier + DH-reload semantics. Game has write-xrefs => non-const; src correctly emits plain uint8 BSS. The existing data documentation lives in Ghidra's PRE_COMMENT (PLATE_COMMENT is null for this data unit); it is semantically consistent with the src conclusion so no plate change made.
